title: Build Strong Programming Fundamentals
description: Start with the basics and gradually learn programming logic, problem-solving, and how to write code that actually works.

title: Understand the Logic Behind Code
description: Instead of just memorizing syntax, learn how to break problems down, think through solutions, and turn your ideas into working code.

title: Put Your Learning Into Practice
description: After learning the fundamentals, apply them through small practical projects that help you understand how programming concepts work together.

title: One-Day Code Projects
description: ODC sessions are dedicated project days. Instead of learning new theory, you use what you've already learned to build a project from start to finish.

title: Learn Beyond the Textbook
description: Get practical insights from real software development, including how the concepts you learn are actually used when building software.

title: Learn Individually or Together
description: Choose between individual classes or small-group learning, depending on what works better for you.
